transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, August 26. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'I don't support the rally': Mamdani opposes RSS chief's Madison Square event. Bhagwat is scheduled to address around 5,000 members of the Indian diaspora at the iconic New York venue on August 29. His visit to the United States is part of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh's centenary-year global outreach programme. "I don't support the rally, but I don't know if the city has any jurisdiction on cancelling a private event," Mamdani said at a news conference on Tuesday. 'Do we need a 4th-party audit?' PM raps secretaries over quality of public projects. Chairing the monthly Pragati meeting on Tuesday, Modi is learned to have told the top bureaucrats that such things are "unacceptable" and the system won't work like this. Modi reviewed six infrastructure projects across railway, road and power sectors, spanning nine states with a cumulative cost of over rupees 30,000 crore. He said infrastructure projects should be viewed and monitored as an integrated whole, rather than as isolated sections, stretches or packages. 'Incredibly emotional': Anaya Bangar gets CA nod for women's cricket, eyes WBBL. Anaya Bangar can play elite women's cricket in Australia starting March 2027. Cricket Australia confirmed her eligibility under its inclusion policy. This decision offers a pathway to the Women's Big Bash League. She must still earn a franchise contract through her performances. Government seeks 2 years to frame creamy layer criteria for PSU, private staff kids. In its application, Centre said, "On account of the serious challenges and implications with the implementation of the directions of SC, govt is committed to bring out a policy which will effectively address the observations made by SC, while also ensuring that the direct and indirect impact of the policy is fair and just." World's first mobile phone call: Cooper dials rival on New York City street. Dr Martin Cooper made the first mobile phone call on April 3, 1973. He called his rival Joel Engel from a New York City street. Motorola and Bell Laboratories pursued different mobile communication approaches then. Cooper's call demonstrated a truly portable mobile phone concept. Of 27 lakh 'logical discrepancy' deletions in West Bengal, only 7 lakh appealed. A bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana was informed by senior advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan that of total 38.1 lakh appeals filed before the SIR appellate tribunals, an overwhelming 31 lakh were filed by those who challenged inclusion of names in the rolls claiming they were ineligible to be voters in Bengal. Congress raises 'pellet guns', BJP counters with 1984 riots at panel meet. A BJP member brought up the "glorification" of anti-Sikh riots convict Sajjan Kumar to counter the Congress's move to raise a matter that was not part of the agenda of "crimes against children". Chugh's remarks drew a sharp reaction from Congress MP Jai Prakash, who said the issue was not relevant at all. BJP has accused Congress MP Deepender Hooda of being laudatory in his tribute to Kumar. Four India-based companies, 3 Indians bear brunt of US's Iran sanctions. The TOI correspondent from Washington: Four India-based companies – and three Indian nationals associated with two of them – have been swept into the Trump administration's new economic offensive against Iran, adding a potentially combustible new layer to the already strained US Defence minister okays DRDO missile tech transfer to private domestic industry. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has given the green light for the transfer of missile technology from the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). This strategic decision is set to significantly enhance domestic industries, curtail reliance on imports, and elevate India's capabilities in defence manufacturing, enabling the local production of guided weapon systems for military applications. Furthermore, this initiative will fortify the defence industrial landscape and encourage the involvement of MSMEs. No intention to quit politics, Nitin Gadkari clarifies. Nitin Gadkari's office said, "In that context, Gadkari said that he could no longer take on as much work as before and that the younger generation should be given an opportunity to take greater responsibility. His remarks were clearly related to the functioning and future leadership of the Trust. However, some television channels are presenting the statement as a political remark, taking it out of its actual context." Minnesota transformed 5,000 acres of old mines into Cuyuna Country. A former Minnesota iron mining area has undergone a remarkable ecological transformation over thirty-three years. Abandoned pits and damaged land now host extensive mountain bike trails and natural shorelines. This restoration effort has revitalized nearby communities and created new outdoor tourism opportunities. The clear, deep mine pit lakes also attract scuba divers and anglers from across the region.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. MP Scraps Stitched Uniform Distribution Plan, To Transfer Uniform Money Directly To Government School Students Via DBT. Madhya Pradesh's school education department has decided to return to Direct Benefit Transfer for uniform assistance, replacing the proposed distribution of stitched uniforms to government school students. MP Cabinet Approves rupees 1,740 Crore For 19 Social Welfare Schemes From 2026 To 2031. The Madhya Pradesh Cabinet has approved rupees 1,740 crore for 19 schemes aimed at the social and economic development of poor and weaker sections and empowerment of divyangjan from 2026 to 2031. MP Cabinet Approves Guarantee For rupees 4,600 Crore MPRDC Loan To Develop 12 Road Routes; rupees 3,960 Crore For Seoni-Balaghat Highway. The Madhya Pradesh Cabinet has approved a government guarantee for a rupees 4,600 crore loan to be taken by MPRDC from NABARD Infrastructure Development Assistance to develop 12 road routes. MP's New Prison Law Stuck For Over 2 Years As Rules Await Approval; Sweeping Jail Reforms Remain On Hold. Madhya Pradesh's prison reform law, passed in July 2024 and approved by the Governor in August that year, is yet to come into force as supporting rules remain under consideration. Post-Harvest Equipment/Machinery Testing Centre at ICAR-CIAE, Bhopal: A Model of Revenue Generation, Technology Validation and Dissemination. Heavy showers bring respite from heat, but leave Bhopal battling waterlogging and traffic. Madhya Pradesh Forest Department To Launch Snake-Catcher App Soon. Baby Born With Four Arms And Four Legs In Madhya Pradesh: Doctors Suspect Rare Conjoined Twin Condition. TATA AIG Sees Strong MSME Growth Potential in Madhya Pradesh. Bhopal gas tragedy: CBI tells court Dow cannot evade Indian jurisdiction over Union Carbide case. IMD issues orange warning for Chhattisgarh, Bihar, Odisha and East Madhya Pradesh. After brief pause, city may get rain today. CBI counsel counters Dow's jurisdiction challenge in BGT liability case. 270 Girls Crammed Into Just Three Rooms At Government Hostel In MP's Khargone As New 500-Bed Facility Awaits Handover. As many as 270 girls from Classes 6 to 11 are sharing just three 10x15-ft rooms at a government school in Selda village of Madhya Pradesh's Bhikangaon tehsil. Worker dies after boom lift runs him over at factory. Just 1.15 Feet to Go: Bhadbhada Gates May Open Soon. Nine people rescued from strong current of Gaderi River in Madhya Pradesh's Sagar district. Tanks, helicopters, combat demos: Bhopal to host Army Day Parade on Jan 15.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Gold Edges Up After Four-Day Gain as Traders Eye Treasury Moves. Gold edged higher as inflation concerns eased, extending a four-day rally sparked by a surprise bond-market intervention that's revived concerns over US fiscal policy and dollar weakness. Bitcoin tops $80,000 as optimistic mood returns to crypto market. Bitcoin crosses $80,000 as ETF inflows, weaker dollar and renewed crypto optimism fuel a sharp rebound, while falling crude prices lift Indian equities Oil Falls on Fresh Iran War Diplomacy, Talks on Hormuz. Oil extended declines as fresh diplomatic efforts helped renew optimism the Iran war would not escalate, while a US plan to ramp up economic pressure on Tehran spared the country's trading partners from harsher measures for now. Nifty Midcap index hits new high as earnings, domestic demand drive gains. Domestic demand, improving earnings drive gains; rich valuations a concern Short Squeeze in US Swaps, Options Shows 'Bessent Put' at Work. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's surprise plan to tamp down US borrowing costs by expanding bond buybacks may have sparked fierce debate about its ultimate effectiveness, but key market metrics and positioning show that it's having an impact. The House of Abhinandan Lodha enters into MoU with NITCO. For joint development of land parcels at Thal and Lonare in Alibaug, Raigad Dollar edges lower as Iran sanctions, Treasury buybacks weighed. GLOBAL-FOREX/ (UPDATE 6, GRAPHICS):FOREX-Dollar edges lower as Iran sanctions, Treasury buybacks weighed United Breweries expands Heineken Silver Across Kerala, Odisha and Madhya Pradesh. Vikram Bahl, Chief Marketing Officer, United Breweries, said, The positive response to Heineken Silver highlights the growing consumer appetite for differentiated premium beer offerings. As we expand into Kerala, Odisha and Madhya Pradesh, we remain focused on strengthening our premium portfolio and making the brand available to more consumers across key markets. Government signals more PSU stake sales after Hindustan Copper OFS: Report. The government's active disinvestment drive targets rupees 80,000 crore for FY27, having raised rupees 52,000 crore so far. First monthly expiry under CAS sees a minor fall in derivatives turnover. Derivatives turnover across indices and stocks stood at rupees 569 trillion, down nearly 4 per cent from the previous monthly expiry, as the new CAS mechanism settles in Stock market open or closed tomorrow on Eid Milad-un-Nabi 2026? Check NSE, BSE trading offs calendar. Despite Eid Milad-un-Nabi, BSE and NSE will operate on August 26, with normal trading but deferred settlements to August 27. The next holiday is Ganesh Chaturthi on September 14. Continuous trading is expected with no interruptions planned in September 2026. HEG demerger becomes effective from 07 Sep 2026. HEG has cleared the final operative steps of its Composite Scheme of Arrangement (Scheme), which will result in the creation of two strong independent listed entities. Vodafone Idea News: Clarification from telecom giant on rupees 53 crore income tax refund order. Vodafone Idea clarified that a Delhi High Court directive regarding a rupees 53.09 crore tax refund is a routine matter and does not require formal disclosure under SEBI regulations. The stock surged 8 percent following the news, as the company prepares to secure significant funding. Sebi bars Varanium Cloud, promoter for 7 years, orders rupees 128.8 crore disgorgement. The market regulator found that the company had misrepresented its financial statements and disclosures, including through fictitious sales and purchases. Noumed Pharmaceuticals renews its supply agreement with leading Australian pharmacy chain. Deal valued at AUD 30 million over 3-year period LS Speaker issues notice to rebel TMC MPs. The Supreme Court issued notice on Abhishek Banerjee's plea concerning disqualification petitions. Varun Beverages to enter alcoholic drinks business, forms new subsidiary. Varun Beverages launches KIVA Spirits to enter the RTD alcohol market. It aims to diversify its product range and enhance its market presence, having recently partnered with Asahi Group and Carlsberg, while also reporting significant profit growth for the June quarter. Fortune expands its mustard oil portfolio with launch of Yellow Mustard Oil. Fortune, the flagship edible oil brand of AWL Agri Business, today announced the launch of Fortune Yellow Mustard Oil, expanding its mustard oil portfolio to cater to consumers who prefer the traditional taste and goodness of Yellow Mustard Oil. Trump's new H-1B fee may make life harder for grads. The Trump administration has proposed a $103,265 fee on employers filing new cap-subject H-1B petitions, including for foreign students already in the US. Scott Bessent's bond buyback strategy draws criticism from Druckenmiller, JPMorgan: 'Paying mortgage with credit card'. The US Treasury's $4 billion increase in long-term bond purchases faces criticism from experts like Stanley Druckenmiller and James Sullivan, who argue it undermines market credibility and fails to address rising government debt supply and future borrowing costs. NBCC bags rupees 122-cr order from Rajasthan Council of School Education. NBCC (India) announced that it has received a work order worth approximately rupees 121.74 crore from the Rajasthan Council of School Education in the ordinary course of business. India signals BIS certificate exemption for tech cos. India is developing a framework to exempt high-tech companies from BIS certification. Taiwan index: Asian bourse jumps 85 percent in one year Top 5 gainers and losers you MUST Know. Taiwanese equities, driven by chip stocks, have emerged as top performers in Asia, with the TAIEX gaining 54.55 percent in 2026. However, recent volatility raises concerns about sustainability as foreign investors withdrew $22.95 billion in July, causing the index to retreat from its peak. GLHRL alters object clause under Memorandum of Association. Global Longlife Hospital and Research has altered its Main Objects under Clause III A of the Memorandum of Association (MOA) by inserting additional sub-clauses to expand and clarify the scope of business activities that the Company is authorised to undertake. RBI's great dollar haul: Where are the $73 bn going?. India has mobilised about $73 billion in foreign currency in under 11 weeks, largely through FCNR(B) deposits, yet the rupee remains near rupees 95-96 per dollar. Retail traded options big time despite curbs , Sebi study. While the active client count fell by a fifth, equity derivatives turnover declined by just 5 percent , with much of this being accounted for by a sharp fall in individual futures turnover. Ritco Logistics arm raises capital rupees 78.26 cr. The newly raised capital of rupees 78.26 crore inside the subsidiary will be deployed to strengthen core technology infrastructure, expand high-tier product engineering and data science teams, accelerate the capabilities of TrucksUp's intelligent freight-matching engine, working capital requirements and general corporate purposes.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Bank holiday today, 26 August: Will SBI, HDFC and others remain open on Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi?. Banks in several Indian states will be closed on August 26 to observe Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi, which celebrates the birth of Prophet Muhammad. Employees exercising their ESOPs should know how a recent ITAT ruling will determine whether the benefit is taxed as perquisite or capital gains. A recent ITAT decision clarified ESOP repurchase taxation. The tax tribunal ruled that repurchased options are capital assets, not perquisites. This decision provides significant relief and clarity for employees and startups. Substance over form prevails, ensuring correct tax treatment regardless of filings. India is going offline again: New study reveals how consumers are moving away from digital payments in 2026. India's lower-middle-class consumers are not abandoning digital channels, but 2026 data shows a surprising shift towards offline transactions. Bill payments, food orders and travel bookings have moved back to physical channels. Filing ITR4 by August 31 deadline? Check these 6 major changes if opting for presumptive taxation for AY 2026-27. For the assessment year 2026-2027, new changes have been introduced impacting those filing ITR-4. Taxpayers need to be aware of six major updates to the form, which encompass revised investment disclosures and updated requirements for reporting house properties. Additionally, claims for political party deductions require specific information now, while the previous reporting relief under Section 89A has been eliminated, with a secondary address now optional. 'House rich, cash poor': Why rupees 2.20 lakh monthly salary doesn't ensure wealth; LinkedIn post sparks discussion. A LinkedIn post highlighted financial challenges faced by professionals with high salaries but high expenses. Many save little due to lifestyle inflation. Have undisclosed foreign assets or income? Know the extra tax cost if you miss FAST Scheme 2026's December 31 deadline. India's FAST Scheme 2026 provides a unique opportunity for taxpayers to declare foreign assets. This voluntary disclosure window closes on December 31st, 2026, offering significant benefits. Taxpayers can regularize undisclosed foreign assets and income by paying a specified tax and penalty. Failure to declare by the deadline will result in harsher penalties under the Black Money Act. Grocery spending falls 8 percent , rent jumps 21 percent : How GST 2.0 is reshaping India's household budgets in 2026. Grocery spending fell 8 percent while rent rose 21 percent , showing a mixed picture for household budgets in 2026. GST 2.0 brought price relief, but families largely used the extra headroom for savings, better food, education, and health rather than splurging. August 31 ITR filing deadline: ITR-3 or ITR-4? Which form you should choose while filing your income tax return. Taxpayers engaged in business activities must submit either ITR-3 or ITR-4 by the deadline of August 31, 2026. While ITR-4 simplifies the process through presumptive taxation, ITR-3 demands a more detailed presentation of accounts. Death of joint home loan borrower: Who pays the EMIs and who owns the house? SC advocate explains. A joint home loan does not automatically mean the surviving borrower gets full ownership of the house if the co-borrower dies. But the survivor remains liable for repaying the entire loan. Here's what a Supreme Court advocate has to say about this. 8th Pay Commission announces Bengaluru meeting schedule: Check dates, deadline to apply and how to take appointment. The 8th Pay Commission is set to convene in Bengaluru, to hold crucial discussions regarding salaries, pensions, and working conditions with a variety of stakeholders. Additional consultations will be organized in cities like Jaipur, Chandigarh, Chennai, and Puducherry during August and September 2026. EPF nomination: Why updating your nominee after marriage and other life changes is important. Many employees nominate someone when they join their first company and then never review the details again. But life circumstances can change significantly over the years Gen Z spending habits: Convenience is key, prefer quick commerce and longer repayment tenure, finds report. Gen Z approaches credit and spending differently from older generations, according to a Kiwi report. Analysing user's spending habits it found they find convenience key, prefer quick commerce and longer repayment tenure. Filed ITR-4 last year? You might need to switch to ITR-3 in AY 2026-27 , here's why. Filing ITR-4 last year does not guarantee you can use the same form this year. Changes in income, business activity, investments, capital gains and other financial circumstances can affect eligibility. Taxpayers should check the key conditions before filing ITR-4 for AY 2026-27. RBI SGB premature redemption calendar 2026-27: Check October-March exit dates and request period for your gold bond investment. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has released Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) premature redemption dates for October 2026 – March 2027. Housing societies cannot charge higher maintenance for bigger flats and shops based on area, rules Maharashtra Co-operative Appellate Court. Unlike property tax, maintenance cannot be charged at a higher rate for bigger flats and shops, explains the Maharashtra Co-operative Appellate Court and gives relief to flat and shop owners from discriminatory higher maintenance. Read the article. SEBI eases NRI KYC rules: Will a fully digital route boost investments in India?. SEBI's proposed digital KYC and onboarding process aims to ease investment for retail NRIs by removing the requirement for physical presence in India. NPS 100 percent equity option explained: How it works, who should consider it and key rules. NPS now allows non-government subscribers to access schemes with up to 100 percent equity exposure under the Multiple Scheme Framework. But higher equity also means higher market risk. Here's what investors should know before choosing the option. Want higher returns without taking much more risk? Add equity, then gold. A study by WhiteOak Capital Mutual Fund reveals that diversification improves risk-adjusted returns. It shows that including a small equity allocation in a debt portfolio can enhance returns and lower volatility Should you close your PPF account after becoming an NRI? Here's what to know about maturity, withdrawal, and tax rules. Moving abroad as an NRI? Your PPF account might not need immediate closure. Discover how your contribution, withdrawal, and maturity options change. Understand the crucial differences between becoming an NRI and a foreign citizen, and navigate the tax implications in your new country of residence. Only 0.5 percent F and O traders make money: Why most keep losing; how to control losses and make trading safer. A SEBI study indicates that 96.5 percent of F and O traders lose after four years, largely due to poor risk management and psychological biases. How India is investing in mutual funds: Longer holding periods, rising equity exposure and changing investor behaviour.
